notes: Grown on a placed farm tile; a tile without a farm object is rejected (src/journey.js gardenAction).
The slowest abundant sowing: forty minutes for the largest base yield in the garden, which the two-step craft chain consumes.

A single tend shortens growth by five minutes, capped by the growth still ahead of the crop. The care bands divide the crop's own forty minutes, so a bountiful grain may be tended inside its first thirteen.
Seeds themselves are free and unlimited; the twenty-crop garden cap is unchanged.
